meta.homeTitle: Venture capital for fintech, blockchain and AI
meta.siteDescription: 01 Capital is a venture firm investing in fintech, blockchain and AI, with an incubation arm that helps founders build and launch.

cta.title: Building in fintech, blockchain or AI?
cta.text: We read every deck. Tell us what you're building and where you need help.

items.title: Domain depth
items.text: Founders with deep knowledge of their market, who ship quickly and learn faster.

items.title: Proof of demand
items.text: A real problem, with evidence that people want it solved: users, revenue, pilots or letters of intent.

items.title: Durable economics
items.text: A business model, and a token model if there is one, that works without relying on the token price.

items.title: Regulatory maturity
items.text: Regulation taken seriously from day one, especially in payments, lending and tokenized assets.

items.title: Essential technology
items.text: Fintech, blockchain or AI that is essential to the product, not decoration.

fintech.name: Fintech
fintech.summary: Payments and stablecoins, wallets and exchanges, lending and credit, and tokenized real-world assets.
fintech.title: Fintech: {em}the rails that move money.{/em}
fintech.metaDescription: How 01 Capital invests in fintech: payments and stablecoins, wallets and exchanges, lending and credit, and real-world asset tokenization.
fintech.view: Financial services are being rebuilt as software, and settlement is moving on-chain. Stablecoins, tokenized assets and programmable wallets let value move at the speed of the internet. We back the companies building those rails, and the products that make them simple, safe and compliant.

focus.title: Payments and stablecoins
focus.text: Cross-border payments, merchant acceptance and treasury tools built on stablecoin rails.

focus.title: Wallets and exchanges
focus.text: Wallets, on- and off-ramps and trading venues that put security and user experience first.

focus.title: Lending and credit
focus.text: Credit products that use on-chain transparency and better data to price risk.

focus.title: Real-world asset tokenization
focus.text: Funds, credit, commodities and other real-world assets brought on-chain, with the legal structures to match.

fintech.lookForTitle: What we look for in fintech founders
lookFor: A clear path to the licenses your markets require.
Unit economics that work at today's volumes, not only at scale.
Distribution you can actually reach: partners, merchants or users.
Security and compliance designed into the product from the start.

blockchain.name: Blockchain
blockchain.summary: Base layers and scaling, decentralized infrastructure, and consumer apps and games.
blockchain.title: Blockchain: {em}infrastructure for an open economy.{/em}
blockchain.metaDescription: How 01 Capital invests in blockchain: base layers and scaling, decentralized infrastructure, and consumer apps and gaming.
blockchain.view: Blockchains are becoming shared infrastructure for finance, data and digital ownership. The winners will be the networks and applications that are fast, secure and simple enough that users never have to think about the chain underneath.

focus.title: Base layers and scaling
focus.text: Networks, rollups and tooling that make blockchains faster, cheaper and easier to build on.

focus.title: Decentralized infrastructure
focus.text: Storage, compute and networking that replace single providers with open markets.

focus.title: Consumer apps and gaming
focus.text: Games, social and entertainment that people choose for the experience, not the token.

blockchain.lookForTitle: What we look for in blockchain founders
lookFor: Real usage that holds up without incentives.
A security model you can explain in plain words.
A token, if there is one, with a clear job in the system.
A team that ships, and supports its developers and users.

ai.name: AI
ai.summary: Decentralized compute and models, AI agents, and applied AI in health and consumer.
ai.title: AI: {em}intelligence as infrastructure.{/em}
ai.metaDescription: How 01 Capital invests in AI: decentralized compute and models, AI agents, and applied AI in health and consumer.
ai.view: AI is becoming a foundational layer of the economy, and it runs on compute, data and trust. We back teams that make AI more open and verifiable, and products where AI does work that customers will pay for.

focus.title: Decentralized compute and models
focus.text: Open networks for training and inference that widen access to compute.

focus.title: AI agents
focus.text: Agents that act on a user's behalf, including agents that can hold and move money safely.

focus.title: Applied AI
focus.text: Products in health, wellness and consumer where AI solves a specific problem better than anything else.

ai.lookForTitle: What we look for in AI founders
lookFor: Proprietary data, distribution or workflow, not a thin layer over someone else's model.
Evidence that customers get value: usage, retention or revenue.
Responsible handling of data and model risk.
A team that pairs AI depth with domain expertise.

hero.title: Where finance, blockchain and AI {em}converge.{/em}
hero.lead: 01 Capital is a venture firm investing in fintech, blockchain and AI, with an incubation arm that helps founders build and launch.

pillars.title: Three pillars. {em}One thesis.{/em}
pillars.lead: Money is becoming software. Blockchains give it a neutral, programmable settlement layer, and AI is making it intelligent. We invest where these shifts meet.

model.title: We invest. {em}We incubate.{/em}
model.lead: Capital is only part of what founders need, so our firm has two arms that work as one team.
model.investText: We back companies building the rails, infrastructure and intelligence of a new financial system, and we stay close long after the first check.
model.incubateText: Our incubation team works alongside founders on strategy, token design, technology, brand and go-to-market, and opens doors across our global network.

items.title: Conviction, not consensus
items.text: We form our own view of a market, and we move with conviction when we find the right team.

items.title: Hands-on from day one
items.text: Our investments come with access to our incubation team, from strategy and token design to technology and go-to-market.

items.title: Aligned for the long term
items.text: We back business models built to last, and we stay involved as companies grow.

incubation.metaDescription: 01 Capital's incubation arm helps founders build and launch: venture building, token design, technology, brand, go-to-market and enterprise Web3 adoption.
incubation.title: We build {em}alongside founders.{/em}
incubation.lead: Our incubation arm gives teams hands-on support from people who have spent more than a decade building in blockchain, from first product to launch and beyond.

items.title: Early-stage founders
items.text: Teams in fintech, blockchain and AI turning a strong idea into a market-ready product.

items.title: Established businesses

services.title: Support at {em}every stage.{/em}
services.lead: Pick what you need. Most teams work with us across several areas.

groups.title: Build
groups.text: Turn an idea into a product people can use.

items.title: Venture building
items.text: From concept to a market-ready product: scoping, resourcing and operational support.

items.title: Token and economic design
items.text: Economic models and tokenomics built around real utility and long-term sustainability.

items.title: Technical support
items.text: Architecture, development and smart contract guidance from our technical and operations team.

groups.title: Launch
groups.text: Reach the right users, partners and markets.

items.title: Brand, community and go-to-market
items.text: Positioning, content, media outreach and community building that earn lasting attention.

items.title: Listing readiness
items.text: Advice on what exchanges look for: documentation, due diligence, compliance and operational readiness.

items.title: Strategy and research
items.text: Market analysis, risk assessment and strategy tailored to your goals, with ongoing monitoring of trends and competitors.

items.title: Global network
items.text: Introductions to industry experts, partners and service providers across our global network.

groups.title: Enterprise
groups.text: Help for traditional businesses moving on-chain.

items.title: Web3 adoption
items.text: Strategy and integration for businesses adopting blockchain, digital assets and smart contracts.

items.title: Real-world asset structuring
